name: trade-server-mcp
description: Trade on a YourBourse Trade Server from Claude — as a trader (login & password) or as a manager/broker (API key & secret).

yb_base_url.title: Server address
yb_base_url.description: Your Trade Server's full web address, from your broker — include https:// and no trailing slash (e.g. https://your-server.example.com, sometimes with a port). Traders use your trading-server address; managers/brokers use your admin API address.

yb_login.title: Account login (traders)
yb_login.description: Traders only — your trading account login (digits only). Leave blank if you're a manager/broker using an API key.

yb_password.title: Password (traders)
yb_password.description: Traders only — your account password. Stored securely in your operating system's keychain. Leave blank if you're using an API key.

yb_broker.title: Broker name (optional)
yb_broker.description: Leave blank unless your broker told you to set it.

yb_api_key.title: API key (managers/brokers)
yb_api_key.description: Managers/brokers only — your API key. Leave blank if you sign in with a login & password.

yb_secret_key.title: API secret (managers/brokers)
yb_secret_key.description: Managers/brokers only — your API secret. Leave blank if you sign in with a login & password.
